description: Defines asynchronous event source and observer classes for handling single async events, including subscription management, timeouts, and result handling within the 'ocudu' namespace.

classes.name: async_event_source
classes.description: Publishes async events, allowing a single subscriber to listen and receive event data, with support for setting observers and timeouts.

classes.name: async_single_event_observer
classes.description: An awaitable, single-use observer for a single async event, supporting subscription, timeout, and result retrieval.

methods.name: has_subscriber
methods.description: Checks if an event source has a registered subscriber.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Forwards a result to the subscriber if present.

methods.name: set_observer
methods.description: Associates an observer with the event source, optionally with a timeout and cancellation value.

methods.name: remove_observer
methods.description: Removes the current observer from the event source.

methods.name: subscribe_to
methods.description: Subscribes the observer to an event source, with optional timeout.

methods.name: connected
methods.description: Checks if the observer is connected to an event source.

methods.name: complete
methods.description: Checks if the event result has been set.

methods.name: result
methods.description: Retrieves the event result, asserting completion.

methods.name: get_awaiter
methods.description: Provides the awaiter for asynchronous waiting on the event.
